en_title: Xbox Mythic Achievement Will Be Microsoft's Version of a Platinum Trophy — And It Has an Extravagant Unlock Sound
cn_title: XBOX神话成就解锁音效曝光
subtitle: 白金奖杯的对手？
opus_summary: 微软预计很快推出XBOX神话成就，作为玩家拿齐游戏全部成就、获得1,000点玩家分数的标记。XBOX PC应用更新文件曝光了约15秒的解锁音效，但微软尚未公布上线时间。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft is expected to imminently launch Xbox Mythic Achievements, its own version of PlayStation's platinum Trophies, and you can now hear how they will sound when unlocked.
paragraphs.cn: 微软预计很快会推出XBOX神话成就，相当于自己的PlayStation白金奖杯。如今，神话成就的解锁音效也已曝光。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has previously confirmed plans to introduce its own method of tracking your full completion of a game — that is, when you have unlocked all of a title's 1,000 Gamerscore by nabbing every single Achievement.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX此前已确认，计划推出一种方式，标记玩家是否拿齐某款游戏的所有成就、获得全部1,000点玩家分数。

paragraphs.en: Now, an update to the Xbox PC app has revealed the sound effect for an Xbox Mythic Achievement being unlocked, which has been discovered buried within the update's files. You can hear its rather majestic audio cue just below, courtesy of Xbox leaker Klobrille.
paragraphs.cn: 现在，有人在XBOX PC应用的更新文件中发现了神话成就的解锁音效。多亏XBOX爆料人Klobrille，你可以在下方听听这段颇为恢宏的音效。

paragraphs.en: A new update for the Xbox PC App reveals: Xbox Mythic Achievement; plus symbol and unlock sound.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX PC应用的新更新曝光了XBOX神话成就，以及它的图标和解锁音效。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox Mythic Achievement is expected to be a 100% Gamerscore game completion reward. pic.twitter.com/STLisa4ubz
paragraphs.cn: XBOX神话成就预计会在玩家拿齐一款游戏的全部玩家分数后解锁。pic.twitter.com/STLisa4ubz

paragraphs.en: The sound is a suitably more grandiose version of the regular achievement unlock ping, which already can be heard in a more dramatic form when a rare achievement (owned by only a small percentage of players) is unlocked instead.
paragraphs.cn: 这段音效比普通成就解锁时的提示音更显隆重。事实上，解锁只有少数玩家获得的稀有成就时，普通提示音就已经会变得更加戏剧化。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft's new Xbox Mythic Achievement effect is longer and more majestic still, lasting around 15 seconds as the audio wooshes in, builds, and then reverberates around. It's satisfying stuff, though whether it'll actually encourage you to grind for hours to get that full 1000G is entirely your choice.
paragraphs.cn: 微软为XBOX神话成就准备的新音效更长，也更恢宏：它持续约15秒，从呼啸声起，逐渐增强，最后留下回响。听起来确实过瘾，但它能否让你愿意花上几个小时刷满1,000点玩家分数，就看你自己了。

paragraphs.en: Back in the day, Xbox Achievements were the first standardized reward system on a console platform, launching in 2005 back on the Xbox 360. The concept was so popular that Valve introduced Steam achievements in 2007, while Sony added Trophies to the PS3 in 2008.
paragraphs.cn: 当年，XBOX成就是主机平台上首个标准化奖励系统，于2005年随XBOX 360推出。这套机制大受欢迎，Valve于2007年推出Steam成就，索尼则在2008年为PS3加入奖杯系统。

paragraphs.en: While games typically share awards lists across platforms (so Xbox Achievements and PlayStation Trophy requirements are typically similar), Sony platforms have long featured the extra Platinum Trophy for most games, unlocked alongside your final regular Trophy. It is a signifier that you have truly mastered everything a game might have to offer, and fans' Platinum Trophy counts have themselves become something to collect and show off.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然游戏在不同平台上的奖励列表通常相通，XBOX成就和PlayStation奖杯的获取条件大多也相近，但长期以来，索尼平台上的大多数游戏还会额外设置白金奖杯。玩家拿到最后一个普通奖杯时，也会解锁白金奖杯。它象征着玩家已真正掌握游戏提供的全部内容，而玩家获得的白金奖杯数量本身，也成了收藏和展示的对象。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft is yet to say when Xbox Mythic Achievements will land across the Xbox ecosystem, but today's leak certainly suggests it won't be long now.
paragraphs.cn: 微软尚未公布XBOX神话成就何时会在XBOX生态系统中上线，但今天的泄露消息表明，这一天可能不远了。
